svg.title: OSW monochrome 56-province lakes cartogram
svg.desc: A monochrome state-map study of the classic 56 Longhurst surface-ocean provinces. Continents are compressed real-coastline holes cut out of the unified ocean field like lakes. Province shapes, sizes, and most internal adjacencies remain schematic and non-metric.
svg.metadata: Original OSW province cartogram, MIT licensed. Continental cutouts use public-domain Natural Earth 1:110m land geometry, commit ca96624a56bd078437bca8184e78163e5039ad19, SHA-256 9e0729ee253ca7d7a5c4ae9395fb1902264c5377c52e224d13dd85010e2835d9, https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nvkelso/natural-earth-vector/ca96624a56bd078437bca8184e78163e5039ad19/geojson/ne_110m_land.geojson. The continental silhouettes are strongly compressed horizontally. No geographic Longhurst boundary dataset is reproduced.

g.aria-label: Continental holes cut from the province field

g.text: ONE FILL · 56 LABELED PIECES · CONTINENTS BECOME NEGATIVE SPACE
Real coastlines cut the edge pieces, but are horizontally compressed.
Province shape, size, distance, and most adjacency remain schematic.
The next study varies the 56 internal puzzle shapes.
